_meta.purpose: Cash input cost per acre for the loan planner (docs/PIVOT.md 3.4, card D1). Cash items only: seed, fertiliser, sprays, land preparation, irrigation, and harvesting/threshing. Land rent and the farmer's own family labour are left out.
_meta.note: Figures are escalated from the official 2023-24 cost table, not quoted today, so the loan planner always carries a COST_ESTIMATE warning.

Wheat.base: Agriculture Policy Institute, Wheat Policy Analysis for 2023-24 Crop, Table-13 (Punjab)
Wheat.method: Non-fertiliser items x 1.119 (CPI FY25 1.045 x FY26 1.071). Fertiliser x 1.253: the Annex-X basket (1 DAP + 2 urea + 0.1 NP + application) re-priced at DAP 15,000 and urea 4,749 per 50 kg bag (data/processed/economics_inputs.json).

items.method: Annex-X basket re-priced (DAP 15,000, urea 4,749 per 50 kg bag)

land_rent.note: Add for tenants; not a cash input the crop needs.

other.note: Mark-up, management and land tax: the loan's own cost is computed separately.
